boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not consciousness, personhood, continuity, employment, or authority evidence.

methods.candidate_workaround: Load cbr/live-performance-remedy-matrix.json for contract-level authority reservations and keep the mutation receipt for mutation counts only.
methods.failure_signature: The first isolated evidence module loaded the CBR mutation receipt when asserting contract-level absent-or-reserved authority fields, causing one KeyError after 17 passing checks.
methods.recurrence_guard: Bind each test assertion to the artifact schema that declares the asserted field.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed module run, award it no aggregate credit, and leave the correct CBR artifacts unchanged.
methods.scope_boundary: Bounded test-surface correction only; no authority, completion, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Bind assertions to the artifact schema that declares the field
trigger_preconditions: A proposal emits separate contract and mutation evidence artifacts.

methods.candidate_workaround: Exclude frozen-chain proposal history and retained failed-witness domains, then scan active v648-v6 schemas, paths, and current origin fields for predecessor drift.
methods.failure_signature: The first evidence stale-label scan treated inherited V6485 proposal IDs and the retained failed Sable-origin witness as active v648-v6 drift.
methods.recurrence_guard: Classify historical and failure-evidence domains before interpreting predecessor tokens as stale.
methods.rollback: Retain the false-positive result, award no hygiene credit, and leave inherited history unchanged.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only label classification; no historical or failure evidence is rewritten.
methods.title: Scope stale-label review around historical evidence
trigger_preconditions: A successor packet embeds frozen proposal history and retained failed witnesses.

methods.candidate_workaround: Use native PowerShell file selection with explicit historical-domain exclusions and exact Select-String patterns.
methods.failure_signature: The first scope-aware stale-label recovery wrapper embedded an unescaped multiline Python string in orchestration source and failed before the shell command ran.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not place raw multiline source inside a quoted orchestration string; use a checked script or native pipeline.
methods.rollback: Retain the orchestration failure, award no scan credit, and rerun only with a parse-safe method.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only workflow recovery; no file or Git state changed in the failed attempt.
methods.title: Avoid raw multiline code inside orchestration strings
trigger_preconditions: A read-only recovery check requires multiline embedded source.

methods.candidate_workaround: Add validation_witness_ids, record each method successfully, then append its witness.
methods.failure_signature: Method Flow records omitted a required schema field and their dependent witness calls failed.
methods.recurrence_guard: Validate required Method Flow fields and gate witness calls on record success.
methods.rollback: Retain all rejected calls and retry only with schema-complete records.
methods.scope_boundary: Bounded Method Flow schema recovery only.
methods.title: Validate Method Flow records before dependent witnesses
trigger_preconditions: A new record and witness are about to be appended.

methods.candidate_workaround: Remove only literal patch-marker characters, preserve every negative object, and parse the exact file.
methods.failure_signature: Patch-addition markers were preserved as literal plus signs in the x2 negative JSON.
methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect generated patch prefixes separately from intended JSON content.
methods.rollback: Retain the invalid parse, award no JSON credit, and remove only the literal markers.
methods.title: Separate patch syntax from JSON content
trigger_preconditions: A generated patch adds JSON objects.

methods.candidate_workaround: Check LASTEXITCODE immediately after every native parser or validator.
methods.failure_signature: A later successful command masked an earlier JSON parser failure.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never rely on the last command's exit code for a multi-command native validation wrapper.
methods.rollback: Retain the misleading wrapper result and rerun with immediate exit propagation.
methods.title: Propagate every native validation exit immediately
trigger_preconditions: Multiple native validation commands share one PowerShell wrapper.

methods.candidate_workaround: Split the repair into small literal apply_patch calls.
methods.failure_signature: A dynamically generated repair wrapper failed with JavaScript syntax error before apply_patch ran.
methods.recurrence_guard: Prefer small literal patches over nested generated-code construction during recovery.
methods.rollback: Retain the pre-execution fault and apply no repository credit to it.
methods.title: Use literal patches for recovery
trigger_preconditions: A recovery patch itself requires complex code generation.

methods.candidate_workaround: Use a template literal with a single-quoted Python payload and immediate LASTEXITCODE propagation.
methods.failure_signature: An incorrectly escaped JavaScript command string failed before shell execution.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use one quoting layer per language and preflight command construction.
methods.rollback: Retain the pre-execution fault and rerun with a parse-safe command.
methods.title: Separate JavaScript, PowerShell, and Python quoting layers
trigger_preconditions: A shell command embeds Python inside orchestration source.

methods.candidate_workaround: Move the JSON sweep into a checked phase-local Python runner and invoke it by filename.
methods.failure_signature: PowerShell stripped inner quotes from an inline Python payload.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use a script file for nontrivial Python under Windows PowerShell.
methods.rollback: Retain the native-binding failure and avoid further inline retries.
methods.title: Use a checked script for JSON sweeps
trigger_preconditions: Nontrivial Python must run under Windows PowerShell native argument binding.

methods.candidate_workaround: Leave the failed method candidate and use the passing replacement as preferred.
methods.failure_signature: The runner rejected a candidate-to-superseded transition.
methods.recurrence_guard: Consult the transition graph and never force lifecycle state for parity.
methods.rollback: Retain the rejected transition and leave the original method candidate.
methods.scope_boundary: Bounded Method Flow lifecycle recovery only.
methods.title: Preserve unpromoted failed methods
trigger_preconditions: A failed workaround has no passing witness but a different method recovers the task.

methods.candidate_workaround: Assert internal count and list parity instead of a fixed operational total.
methods.failure_signature: A checked JSON runner's fixed expected count drifted after new retained failures.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use invariant parity checks for append-only ledgers.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed runner invocation and do not lower the negative count.
methods.title: Validate append-only ledgers by internal parity
trigger_preconditions: A ledger may gain retained entries during the phase.

methods.candidate_workaround: Pass a literal directory root to ripgrep and put wildcard matching in a -g filter.
methods.failure_signature: Native ripgrep rejects wildcard-bearing Windows path arguments with operating-system error 123.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use literal search roots and -g filename filters for all Windows ripgrep calls.
methods.rollback: Retain both failed invocations and discard their partial output as a passing witness.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only native search construction on Windows only.
methods.title: Separate Windows search roots from glob filters
trigger_preconditions: A native search requires wildcard filename selection on Windows.
